snippet.title: Chosen of God Playtest 2026 #gamedev #games  #indiegamedevs #gaming #gameplay #indiegamedev #bible
snippet.description:
*Chosen of God* is a fast-paced Action RPG inspired by the biblical epic of David. The game captures the speed and kinetic impact of classic hack-and-slash titles, elevated by the tactical depth of Soulslike combat where timing, positioning, and reading your opponent draw the line between victory and defeat. It is a direct, addictive journey built for players who want to feel powerful in the arena without sacrificing deliberate strategy.

 *"This is more than a story of faith; it is a technical war dance where true strength is forged not in steel, but in conviction. Stepping into David's shoes, your trust in God becomes an unstoppable weapon to fell giants and conquer entire realms."*

Set at the dawn of 1000 BC, you will step into the sandals of the young shepherd turned warrior, facing ruthless beasts, battle-hardened champions, and legendary colossi. Every encounter is a duel of reflexes that rewards precision over brute force.

- *Progression & Mastery:* Advance your build, optimize core attributes, and master the flow of combat.
- *Adaptive Arsenal:* Discover, forge, and equip weapons and armor to shape the hero around your personal playstyle.
- *A Hostile World to Explore:* Traverse vivid, perilous environments—from scorching deserts to rugged valleys teeming with secrets.

*Chosen of God* is an epic adventure of courage, resilience, and the unyielding power of faith. Through David’s journey, you will discover an experience proving that no obstacle—and no giant—is insurmountable when purpose and conviction in God guide your path.
